DECLARE @RPTSTR DATE = '{0}'; DECLARE @RPTEND DATE = '{1}';
WITH CTE_ZOLLPRD AS ( SELECT ZOLLLOT_0 , ITMREF_0 , SUM(IIF(IPTDAT_0 < @RPTSTR, 1, 0) * QTYSTU_0) QTY2BEG -- 上期之前有的交易数量 , SUM(IIF(IPTDAT_0 BETWEEN @RPTSTR AND @RPTEND , 1 , 0)) TRXPRD -- 本期发生的记录数 , SUM(IIF(IPTDAT_0 <= @RPTEND, 1, 0) * QTYSTU_0) QTY2END -- 截止到本期末的交易数量 FROM YZUPZOLL WHERE IPTDAT_0 <= @RPTEND GROUP BY ZOLLLOT_0 , ITMREF_0 ) , CTE_ZOLLPRD_ZOLLLOT AS ( -- SELECT ZOLLLOT_0 , SUM(IIF(IPTDAT_0 < @RPTSTR, 1, 0) * QTYSTU_0) QTY2BEG -- 上期之前有的交易数量 , SUM(IIF(IPTDAT_0 BETWEEN @RPTSTR AND @RPTEND , 1 , 0)) TRXPRD -- 本期发生的记录数 , SUM(IIF(IPTDAT_0 <= @RPTEND, 1, 0) * QTYSTU_0) QTY2END -- 截止到本期末的交易数量 FROM YZUPZOLL WHERE IPTDAT_0 <= @RPTEND GROUP BY ZOLLLOT_0 ) , CTE_ZOLLPRD1 AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ZLI.ZOLLLOT_0 , ZLI.ITMREF_0 , ZLI.QTY2BEG , ZLI.QTY2END , ZLI.TRXPRD -- , ZL.QTY2BEG ZLQTY2BEG -- , ZL.QTY2END ZLQTY2END -- , ZL.TRXPRD ZLTRXPRD FROM CTE_ZOLLPRD ZLI LEFT JOIN CTE_ZOLLPRD_ZOLLLOT ZL ON ZL.ZOLLLOT_0 = ZLI.ZOLLLOT_0 WHERE ZLI.QTY2BEG > 0 -- 按监管批次+产品，截止到上期末有库存 OR ZLI.TRXPRD > 0 -- 本按监管批次+产品，期有发生交易 OR ZL.QTY2BEG > 0 -- 按监管批次，截止到上期末有库存 OR ZL.TRXPRD > 0 -- 按监管批次，本期有发生交易 -- 只要有一个条件符合，就需要保留下来 ) SELECT Z.ZOLLLOT_0 监管批次 , Z.ITMREF_0 产品编码 , Z.QTY2BEG 上期末数量 , Z.QTY2END 本期末数量 , Z.TRXPRD 本期发生的记录数 , C.* FROM CTE_ZOLLPRD1 Z LEFT JOIN YZUPCUI C ON C.MRNPOSNO_0 = Z.ZOLLLOT_0 AND C.ITMREF_0 = Z.ITMREF_0 ORDER BY Z.ZOLLLOT_0 , Z.ITMREF_0
